Hi Nikhil,

We're starting vendor setup for Redwood Inference ahead of our PO issuance. Procurement needs the following items to complete our onboarding and security review:

- Fully executed Data Processing Agreement (or DocuSign link)
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest) or secure link to download
- Current subprocessor list (including hosting and telemetry vendors)
- Completed vendor onboarding form (we have a standard PDF to upload)
- W-9 or relevant tax form for US vendors

Can you share those documents and confirm your PO process (preferred invoice format, billing contact, lead time from PO to invoice)? Also please include a legal contact in case of contract questions or redlines.

We'd like to complete the paperwork this week if possible — our target PO issuance is next Tuesday.
